scope: Read-only local source/schema/development-history audit for real part3 response research

operations.other_CSV_reads: SGSC headers only; no response rows parsed

main_conclusion: Local data include genuine price-response material, strongest iFlex and Swiss residential tariffs; genuine EV waveforms alone do not supply ex-ante compensation. No currently prepared local dataset directly provides a validated continuously randomized scalar EV compensation-to-physical-duration gold curve. Real-data work can proceed using an explicit price-path or factual prediction target, without manufacturing prices or causal truth.

sources.real_price_and_response: Yes: experiment_days maps phase/date/group to assigned Price_signal; price_signals maps Price_signal/hour to real trial price; hourly household demand can be matched through phase/group/date/hour and anonymous household ID. Prior component already checked these joins on its Phase1 sample.

minimum_feasible_real_validation.priority: Recover iFlex Phase2 response archive and prove source joins/design support before fitting. Keep trial-path outcomes distinct from EV-duration simulation outcomes.
minimum_feasible_real_validation.target_first: All assigned eligible households' factual hourly/daily load or energy under a declared full-day price path, plus design-supported discrete-path ITT/controlled aggregate effects. State unit and price-path assignment rather than rename household demand as EV response seconds.
split: First create prior-use inventory; Phase1 retrospective results remain development knowledge

Freeze truly unused whole dates/periods and households before outcomes/model outputs are examined; prefer separate new-user and later-period evaluations, with a crossed holdout if adequately supported
Keep a shared assigned group-day/24h path wholly inside one fold; never randomly split its hours or label households sharing that intervention as independent randomizations

Use only pre-notification history. Fit scalers/feature selection/weather/load nuisance models on training folds; personal pre-event history for new users is allowed only if explicitly declared and genuinely available
Use sufficient separation or purging for overlapping outcome windows; do not use heldout outcome hours in baseline construction. Respect phase-specific notification cutoff and future information
Cluster uncertainty by actual assignment/date dependence; household and time dependence may both matter. Report independent date/group-day counts, not hourly row count as N

metrics.name: Factual out-of-sample load/energy MAE and RMSE
metrics.meaning: Prediction/generalization error under assigned observed conditions, not continuous causal-curve gold error

metrics.name: Assigned-path/group-day aggregate calibration
metrics.reference: Heldout observed means or design-based randomized group contrasts, with control adjustment and sampling uncertainty
metrics.meaning: Agreement at supported randomized/discrete interventions; group means are noisy references, not exact individual counterfactual truth

metrics.name: Comparison with calendar/history baseline and price-free predictor
metrics.reference: Same heldout households/whole periods and same coverage
metrics.meaning: Incremental predictive value of legally available price/state information

metrics.name: Support and output coverage
metrics.reference: Designed households, group-days, dates, price paths, matched meters and missingness
metrics.meaning: Whether effects/curves can be estimated in the declared domain, separate from accuracy

metrics.name: Predeclared control/non-event placebo and baseline sensitivity
metrics.reference: Real comparison periods and alternative legal baseline definitions
metrics.meaning: Detect spurious patterns and baseline sensitivity; absence of placebo significance does not prove no confounding

metrics.name: Effect estimates, clustered intervals and period stability
metrics.reference: Trial design and independent date blocks
metrics.meaning: Real supported treatment contrasts; cannot report interval coverage without known true effects

do_not_use: RMSE against an invented real counterfactual mean curve
Percent causal accuracy from prediction R2/MAE
Realized rebate or realized electricity bill as ex-ante treatment
Independently learned model as gold truth
Forced zero or deleted negative/weak response
Synthetic price attached to real waveforms
Treating finite price paths or repeated tariffs as pure continuous-dose density
minimum_feasible_real_validation.continuous_extension_gate: If the actual design is14 discrete24h paths, first use its appropriate discrete/path analysis. A smooth scalar curve may be exploratory conditional association or interpolation at supported design points, but does not validate the present pure-continuous scalar DR estimand. Establish a defensible scalar intervention/conditioning set and overlap before reusing continuous-density claims.
minimum_feasible_real_validation.what_current_simulation_still_does: Known-truth continuous contrast/derivative RMSE remains a separate algorithm benchmark. Real factual prediction and trial contrasts complement it; do not merge their metrics into one accuracy.
